Corrected in cwaf by context-keyed basis_spread corrections (first-out C_877bda4e -> 10.00, last-out C_287d1960 -> 9.00, each with its printed line); cwaf publishes margin 10.00 / 9.00 and pik_rate 15.44 / 14.44 as printed.

Alternative tested: publish the margin (9.00 / 10.00) as pik_rate. Rejected: the cash leg (interest_rate minus pik_rate) would then be 5.44 on a loan that pays no cash, and it would differ from the later quarters of the same loans.
